kaikki_vikisozluk.e: مَرْسَى الشَّيْخ بَرْغُوت • (marsā š-šayḵ barḡūt) m
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Superficially literally “anchorage of the shaykh of the flea”, with a name looking like the Sudanese Arabic form بَرْغُوت (barḡūt) of بُرْغُوث (burḡūṯ, “flea”), related to be the name of a faqih whose tomb was to the north of the original anchorage, however from Beja baarʼuut referring to that sea-mark, of unknown further etymology.
g: the name of Port Sudan, a city in Sudan, before its expansion in 1900–1909 from an anchorage to a port
